name: maxio-sdk-exp1-agents
description: EXPERIMENTAL VARIANT of maxio-sdk (map + skills, v0.1.1 data layer plus generated map enrichments: operation Notes from XML remarks, literal enum member names, namespaces, literal-parameter-name headers) adding subagent orchestration: an integrate-maxio router, a maxio-plan agent that produces a map-grounded contract sheet with no open lookups before any code is written (the rare map-side gap becomes a defensive directive or a row flagged for maxio-debug), and a maxio-debug agent whose first step on SDK-name errors is the map row (cloning SDK source itself only when the map already matches the code or ambiguity remains). Tests whether procedural structure rescues weak models and cuts main-context cost. Not for production install.
